# SetModels

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed record SetModels
```

`set.json`'s record of the 3D models a cook made. Additive and optional, so `Schema.Current` is not bumped; absent means the Set was cooked without models.

**Parameters**

- `Format` (`string`) - The model format token, as the CLI spells it (`glb`, ...).
- `Pivot` (`string`) - The pivot token, as the CLI spells it (`bottom-center`, ...).
- `VoxelSize` (`float`) - World units per voxel.
- `Skipped` (`IReadOnlyList<int>?`) - Set numbers with no model because nothing in them is fully opaque, ascending. Null when none.
